$comment: MySQL 8.x / MariaDB 10.4-11 built-in functions and system variables (plan-batch3 WP-MY). `since` tags MySQL-only (MySQL 8.0) and MariaDB-only (MariaDB x.y) functions. Generated; same shape as sqlite-functions.json.

functions.name: ascii
functions.doc: Numeric code of the leftmost character of str (0 for an empty string).

functions.name: bin
functions.doc: Binary string representation of n.

functions.name: bit_length
functions.doc: Length of str in bits.

functions.name: char
functions.doc: Characters for the given integer codes (binary string unless USING charset is given).

functions.name: char_length
functions.doc: Length of str in characters.

functions.name: character_length
functions.doc: Synonym for CHAR_LENGTH().

functions.name: concat
functions.doc: Concatenation of the arguments; NULL if any argument is NULL.

functions.name: concat_ws
functions.doc: Concatenation with a separator; NULL arguments are skipped.

functions.name: elt

functions.name: export_set

functions.name: find_in_set

functions.name: length

functions.name: lower
functions.doc: str in lower case.

functions.name: ltrim
functions.doc: str without leading spaces.

functions.name: mid

functions.name: reverse
functions.doc: str with the characters in reverse order.

functions.name: right
functions.doc: The rightmost len characters of str.

functions.name: soundex
functions.doc: Soundex string of str.

functions.name: space
functions.doc: A string of n spaces.

functions.name: exp

functions.name: floor

functions.name: least

functions.name: ln

functions.name: log

functions.name: log2
functions.doc: Base-2 logarithm of x.

functions.name: mod

functions.name: tan

functions.name: truncate
functions.doc: x truncated to d decimal places.

functions.name: @@lock_wait_timeout
functions.doc: Timeout for metadata locks (seconds).

functions.name: @@innodb_lock_wait_timeout
functions.doc: Timeout for InnoDB row locks (seconds).

functions.name: @@wait_timeout
functions.doc: Idle seconds before the server closes the connection.

functions.name: @@group_concat_max_len
functions.doc: Maximum length of a GROUP_CONCAT() result.

functions.name: @@foreign_key_checks
functions.doc: 0 disables foreign key checks for the session.

functions.name: @@unique_checks
functions.doc: 0 relaxes unique checks for bulk loads.

functions.name: @@sql_safe_updates
functions.doc: 1 refuses UPDATE/DELETE without a key in WHERE or a LIMIT.

functions.name: @@last_insert_id
functions.doc: Value returned by LAST_INSERT_ID().

functions.name: @@identity
functions.doc: Synonym for @@last_insert_id.

functions.name: @@warning_count
functions.doc: Warnings of the last statement.

functions.name: @@error_count
functions.doc: Errors of the last statement.

functions.name: @@datadir
functions.doc: Data directory of the server.

functions.name: @@secure_file_priv
functions.doc: Directory LOAD DATA / SELECT INTO OUTFILE may use.

functions.name: @@server_id
functions.doc: Replication server id.

functions.name: @@read_only
functions.doc: 1 when the server refuses writes from non-SUPER users.

functions.name: @@log_output
functions.doc: Destination of the general and slow query logs (FILE, TABLE, NONE).

functions.name: @@general_log
functions.doc: 1 when the general query log is on.

functions.name: @@slow_query_log
functions.doc: 1 when the slow query log is on.

functions.name: @@long_query_time
functions.doc: Slow query threshold in seconds.

functions.name: @@default_storage_engine
functions.doc: Engine of new tables (InnoDB).

functions.name: @@lower_case_table_names
functions.doc: How table names are stored and compared (0 case-sensitive, 1 lower case, 2 lower-case compare).

functions.name: @@in_transaction
functions.doc: 1 inside an open transaction (MariaDB).

functions.name: @@session.sql_mode
functions.doc: Session value of sql_mode.

functions.name: @@global.sql_mode
functions.doc: Global value of sql_mode.

operators.doc: NULL-safe equality: 1 when both operands are equal or both NULL, never NULL.
JSON column path: col->'$.path' is JSON_EXTRACT(col, '$.path').
JSON column path, unquoted: col->>'$.path' is JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(col, '$.path')).
Assignment to a user variable inside an expression (@n := @n + 1); deprecated outside SET.
Remainder of an integer division (same as %).
Logical OR (string concatenation with sql_mode PIPES_AS_CONCAT).
